## Overview

**Hello Pico** is the introductory lab of the Open Engineering Academy.
You will author one Rule, run the Parser to turn it into an internal
representation, and use the Composer to produce a working
`hello-world-pico`.

The lab is intentionally small — 30 to 45 minutes — and is the reference
implementation of the shared lab structure documented under
`templates/lab/` in the source repository (in-repo scaffold, not
published as a learner page).

## What you will produce

A single artifact named `hello-world-pico` — matching the `produces`
entry in the [pico course metadata](../../courses/pico/metadata.yaml).

## Downloads and screenshots

Starter files live under `downloads/`. Screenshots referenced from the
walkthrough live under `screenshots/`. Both directories are kept even
when empty so authors have a consistent place to add assets.

## Constructive realization

This lab is the **Realization** of the Hello Pico Definition stated in
the Pico course. For the concrete Definition → Realization → Element
mapping, with the Constraints this lab's Element must satisfy and the
Validations that check them, see
[Hello Pico as a constructive exemplar](../../courses/pico/hello-pico-exemplar.html).
